SELECT FROM procurement_pending_purchase
AND site LIKE CONCAT('%', #{site}, '%')
AND sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sku}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, purchase_time DESC, id DESC
